scientific_integrity: The universal formula is proved analytically from the forcing rule. Exact rational exhaustive computation through order 8 is used only as a stress test, and published clique, star, and complete-bipartite formulas are checked as specializations. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple complete multipartite graphs under the synchronous transmission-zero-forcing rule with one transmission per filled vertex. It does not address propagation time or repeated-transmission variants. Literature non-detection is not a proof of global novelty.
title: Transmission zero forcing of complete multipartite graphs
